context: Riku asks Aoi about her part-time job.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (勤務/バイト/出席/継続/文書) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: アオイさん、バイト長いんだよね?
lines.en: Aoi, you've worked this part-time job a while, right?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, bright warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、三年も継続してるんだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I've kept it up for three years.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: How many times a week do you work?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 四日くらい、勤務してるよ。
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 学校の出席と、両立できてる?
lines.en: Can you balance it with school attendance?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 出席も、ちゃんとしてるよ。
lines.en: I keep up my attendance too.
lines.style: proud barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: バイトの契約、文書であるの?
lines.en: Is the part-time contract in a document?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、文書をもらって、継続してるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I got a document and keep going.
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
